deviation.name: Barbed Glyphs
deviation.description: Each Glyph inflicts a small amount of damage when collected.

risks.name: Fortified Foes
risks.description: Guardian Eximus units may be encountered, including Guardian Eximus Necramechs.

risks.name: Devil's Bargain
risks.description: Allies within 4m of slain enemies gain 25% Fire Rate at the cost of -50% Ammo Efficiency.

deviation.name: Sealed Armor
deviation.description: Enemies take 90% less damage from non-Weak Point hits.

risks.name: Bolstered Belligerents
risks.description: All enemies have Overguard equal to 50% of their max health.

deviation.name: Coordinated Front
deviation.description: Eximus units support The Fragmented Tide and its final form.

risks.name: Postmortal Surges
risks.description: Slain enemies burts with Void energy.

risks.name: Vampyric Liminus
risks.description: Slow moving, immortal, Duviri Liminus drain health and energy from allies who get too close.

deviation.name: Cache Crash
deviation.description: Consequences of opening a Supply Cache are active from the start and will intensify if the Supply Cache is opened. Failure to open a Supply Cache doubles the kill count required to finish the mission.

risks.name: Dense Fog
risks.description: Efervon gas blankets the level. Enemies may drop filters that can provide a temporary reprieve.

risks.name: Corrupted Flesh
risks.description: Techrot enemies are infused with Efervon and take damage over time. They explode when killed and leave behind deadly Efervon in their wake.

deviation.name: Vampire Rock
deviation.description: Flare creates a field that disrupts player abilities while draining energy to boost Flare's health. Flare slowly loses health when no players are in range.

risks.name: Balloonfest
risks.description: Scaldra Harbingers are more numerous and attack and move more quickly.

risks.name: Bolstered Belligerents
risks.description: All enemies have Overguard equal to 50% of their max health.

deviation.name: Parallel Evolution
deviation.description: As the Legacyte evolves other enemies present also gain new abilities.

risks.name: Arcade Automate
risks.description: Enemy guns launch large, slow moving orbs instead of their usual ordnance.

risks.name: Beyond The Wall
risks.description: Murmur enemies join Scaldra and Techrot forces.

upgrade.title: Toxic Shot
upgrade.description: Add 25% Gas Status Chance to Primary and Secondary weapons.

upgrade.title: More the Merrier
upgrade.description: Non-Tenno Allies within 20m all gain +5% Melee Attack Speed and +20% Fire Rate for each one in range.

upgrade.title: Status Chance Per Ammo Spent
upgrade.description: [PH] Status Chance Per Ammo Spent Desc

upgrade.title: Targeted Medicine
upgrade.description: Shoot Health Orbs to pick them up. Health orbs now have 25% chance to duplicate when picked up.

challenge.title: Make it personal
challenge.description: Kill 250 Scaldra Troops with Melee Weapons

upgrade.title: Punchcard
upgrade.description: Add +1.5m punch through to primary weapons.

upgrade.title: Psionic Feedback
upgrade.description: On Damaged 10% chance to set off a 250 damage, 5m radius blast of radiation on taking damage.
